text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: We've got a gathering of only the fastest racers here at Tokyo Racecourse in Fuchu! Ladies and gentlemen, you are about to witness history in the making!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Lady Ardan…
…Allow me to see what you're made of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There's something I'd like to say before the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Having you as my trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Has truly made me happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I ask that you watch closely, and witness the instance in which all the moments we've shared come together to shatter the preordained outcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I shall do my best.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Everyone's in such tip-top form.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, this is real dandy. Now we can get this show on the road!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …This is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I won't be defeated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Oguri, Creek, and Inari.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I extend my gratitude to you all… for living alongside me in this moment, and for shining on with your brilliant radiance.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Those vivid and dazzling days my precious rivals gifted me…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Wonderful memories of the races in which we surpassed our limits together…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I shall turn each and every one of these moments into the shining light of my current self.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let's begin…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Our autumn Tenno Sho!
